title: Console Tooling Standup - 2026-03-10
content:
Standup notes (quick, rough) - console/tooling team - Tuesday 2026-03-10
Attendees: Emily, Ravi, Sofia, Miguel, Aisha (remote)

Quick updates:
- Emily: UI rollout gating + rollout dashboard. Canary at 35% for route-based rollouts, latency looks ok except occasional p95 spikes (~120ms -> 240ms) around 09:40 PST. Investigating correlation with background cache refresh. Follow-up: trace id examples in PR logs. (See CONSOLE-3421)
- Ravi: Analytics pipeline - fixed bad aggregation bug on per-route cost. Deployed patch to staging; needs smoke test on prod metrics before we widen. Patch PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/412.
- Sofia: Feature flag UI improvements - redesigned flag details modal, added last-changed-by and rollout history. Waiting on accessibility review. Blocker: design token mismatch between new DS v2 and legacy components (UI-128).
- Miguel: Rollout automation - canary autoscale rule added for dedicated pools. Need to validate throttling behavior under parallel requests. WIP on ROLLOUT-59.
- Aisha: Observability/tracing - dashboard tagging for canary traces; noticed some traces losing route metadata when fallback path triggered. Filed ANALYTICS-77.

Blockers:
- DS v2 tokens causing contrast issues in dark mode, affecting modal labels (UI-128). Blocks QA for flag UI. Owner: Sofia. ETA: 2026-03-12 for temp fix.
- Cache refresh causing p95 spikes in canary window. Hypothesis: background rehydration task running on a single node causing IO pressure. Owner: Emily + infra. Need heap/IO metrics from SRE. Follow-up: add additional tracing span around cache refresh.
- Analytics aggregation issue (previously fixed) still showing stale values in last 10m window on prod. Owner: Ravi. Action: run backfill and check eventual consistency; add alert on delta > 5% (ANALYTICS-77).

Decisions/Notes:
- Proceed with slow canary (35% -> 60% over 24h) for route-based rollout pending no new errors. If p95 > 200ms for 3 consecutive 5-min windows, rollback automatically. Added threshold to ROLLOUT-59.
- Flag UI accessibility review required before full rollout. Canary will not expose flag-edit to EDGE users until review passes.
- Blocker tickets prioritized for this sprint; will re-evaluate if new regressions appear during canary.

Action items (owner - due):
- Emily: Add cache refresh tracing spans + sample trace capture for 2026-03-10 canary window. Due: 2026-03-11. Linked: CONSOLE-3421.
- Ravi: Run analytics backfill for last 6 hours and validate per-route costs; post results to #console-observability. Due: 2026-03-10 EOD. Linked: ANALYTICS-77.
- Sofia: Patch DS tokens to restore contrast in dark mode (temporary CSS override) and open PR. Due: 2026-03-12. Linked: UI-128.
- Miguel: Run load test with canary autoscale rule against staging and share results. Due: 2026-03-11. Linked: ROLLOUT-59.
- Aisha: Add route metadata to fallback traces and update dashboard; small follow-up PR. Due: 2026-03-11.

Follow-ups / things to watch:
- Watch p95 latency and error budget during next 12h of canary. If any regression, trigger immediate rollback and call quick postmortem.
- Confirm that dedicated-pool autoscale rule doesn't cause cross-tenant noisy neighbor issues in staging.
- Confirm analytics alerts are firing correctly after backfill (Ravi).

Meeting artifacts and refs:
- Canary dashboard: Confluence page link above and dashboard in Grafana (dashboard id: console-rollout-canary)
- PRs: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/412 (analytics fix), github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/415 (DS token hotfix - WIP)
- Tickets: CONSOLE-3421 (canary latency investigation), UI-128 (DS tokens), ROLLOUT-59 (canary autoscale), ANALYTICS-77 (aggregation/backfill)

Notes to self / informal:
- need better signal for cache refresh windows (maybe emit metric 'cache.refresh.start' with node id)
- consider adding rate-limiter for cache rehydration tasks across nodes
- quick reminder: ping platform SRE about IO quotas on new GPU nodes (might be unrelated but worth checking)

Next standup: 2026-03-11 09:30 PST.

End of notes (raw, unpolished)
